# 4 Ezra Chapter 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Eagle vision interpreted

---

**12:1** And-it-came-to-pass while-the-lion-was-speaking-these-words to-the-eagle, I-saw

**12:2** and-behold! the-remaining-head-disappeared. And-the-two-wings-that-had-joined-with-it-arose and-set-themselves-up-to-reign, and-their-reign-was-short-and-full-of-uproar.

**12:3** And-I-saw, and-behold: they-also-disappeared, and-the-whole-body-of-the-eagle-was-burned, and-the-earth-was-exceedingly-terrified.

**12:4** Then-I-was-awakened-from-the-trance-that-held-me-as-in-deep-sleep, and-great-terror-was-upon-me; and-I-said-to-my-spirit:

**12:5** Behold, what-have-you-done-to-me, in-that-you-searched-out-the-ways-of-the-Most-High?

**12:6** I-am-still-weary-in-my-mind and-very-feeble-in-my-spirit; and-there-is-not-the-least-strength-in-me because-of-the-great-fear-with-which-I-was-terrified-tonight.

**12:7** Now-therefore-I-will-beseech-the-Most-High that-he-may-strengthen-me-unto-the-end.

**12:8** And-I-said: O-LORD-my-God, if-I-have-found-favor-in-your-sight, and-if-I-am-justified-before-you-above-many-others, and-if-my-prayer-has-indeed-come-up-before-your-face:

**12:9** strengthen-me and-show-me your-servant the-interpretation and-meaning-of-this-fearful-vision, that-you-may-fully-comfort-my-soul.

**12:10** For-you-have-judged-me-worthy-to-be-shown-the-end-of-the-times and-the-last-events-of-the-times.

**12:11** And-he-said-to-me: This-is-the-interpretation-of-this-vision which-you-saw:

**12:12** The-eagle-whom-you-saw-come-up-from-the-sea is-the-fourth-kingdom-which-appeared-in-a-vision-to-your-brother-Daniel.

**12:13** But-it-was-not-expounded-to-him-as-I-now-expound-it-to-you or-as-I-have-expounded-it.

**12:14** Behold, the-days-come-that-there-shall-rise-a-kingdom-on-earth, and-it-shall-be-more-terrible-than-all-the-kingdoms-that-were-before-it.

**12:15** And-in-it-shall-rule-twelve-kings, one-after-another.

**12:16** But-the-second-that-is-to-reign-shall-hold-rule-longer-than-any-of-the-twelve.

**12:17** This-is-the-interpretation-of-the-twelve-wings-you-saw.

**12:18** And-whereas-you-heard-a-voice-that-spoke-not-from-its-heads-but-from-the-midst-of-its-body, this-is-the-interpretation:

**12:19** There-shall-arise-great-contentions-in-the-midst-of-it, and-it-shall-be-in-danger-of-falling; nevertheless-it-shall-not-then-fall, but-shall-be-restored-again-to-its-original-power.

**12:20** And-whereas-you-saw-eight-small-wings-clinging-to-its-wings, this-is-the-interpretation:

**12:21** Eight-kings-shall-arise-in-it, whose-times-shall-be-small-and-their-years-swift.

**12:22** And-two-of-them-shall-perish when-the-middle-time-approaches; four-shall-be-kept-until-the-time-when-its-end-shall-approach; but-two-shall-be-kept-until-the-end-itself.

**12:23** And-whereas-you-saw-three-heads-at-rest, this-is-the-interpretation:

**12:24** In-its-last-days-the-Most-High-will-raise-up-three-kings, and-they-shall-renew-many-things-in-it, and-shall-rule-the-earth

**12:25** and-its-inhabitants-with-much-oppression, more-than-all-those-who-were-before-them; therefore-they-are-called-the-heads-of-the-eagle.

**12:26** For-these-are-they-who-shall-bring-to-a-head his-wickedness and-shall-accomplish-his-last-deeds.

**12:27** And-whereas-you-saw-the-great-middle-head-disappear, one-of-the-kings-shall-die-in-his-bed, but-yet-in-anguish.

**12:28** But-the-two-that-remain-shall-be-slain-by-the-sword.

**12:29** For-the-sword-of-one-shall-devour-the-other; but-at-the-last-he-also-shall-fall-by-the-sword.

**12:30** And-whereas-you-saw-the-two-small-wings-passing-over-to-the-head-that-was-on-the-right-side:

**12:31** This-is-the-interpretation: these-are-they-whom-the-Most-High-has-kept-unto-the-end: this-is-the-small-kingdom and-full-of-trouble, as-you-saw.

**12:32** And-the-lion-whom-you-saw-rising-out-of-the-forest, roaring-and-speaking-to-the-eagle, and-reproving-it-for-its-unrighteousness, and-all-its-words-that-you-have-heard —

**12:33** this-is-the-Messiah whom-the-Most-High-has-kept-until-the-end-of-days, who-shall-spring-from-the-seed-of-David, and-shall-come-and-speak-to-them; he-shall-denounce-them-for-their-wickedness-and-righteousness-from-them — their-wicked-deeds.

**12:34** For-first-he-shall-set-them-living-before-his-judgment-seat, and-when-he-has-reproved-them, then-he-shall-destroy-them.

**12:35** But-the-rest-of-my-people-he-shall-deliver-in-mercy — those-who-have-been-preserved-throughout-my-borders — and-he-shall-make-them-joyful-until-the-end-comes, the-day-of-judgment, of-which-I-spoke-to-you-at-the-beginning.

**12:36** This-is-the-dream-which-you-saw, and-this-is-its-interpretation.

**12:37** And-you-alone-were-worthy-to-learn-this-secret-of-the-Most-High.

**12:38** Write-therefore-all-these-things which-you-have-seen-in-a-book, and-put-it-in-a-hidden-place.

**12:39** And-you-shall-teach-them-to-the-wise-among-your-people, whose-hearts-you-know-will-be-able-to-comprehend-and-keep-these-secrets.

**12:40** But-do-not-abide-here-yourself, but-go-to-a-place-where-none-of-mortal-kind-has-dwelt.

**12:41** For-you-shall-be-taken-up-from-among-men, and-from-henceforth-you-shall-dwell-with-my-son and-with-those-who-are-like-you, until-the-times-are-ended.

**12:42** For-the-world-has-lost-its-youth, and-the-times-begin-to-wax-old.

**12:43** For-the-whole-world-has-been-divided-into-ten-parts, and-nine-parts-of-it-are-already-passed-and-gone; and-the-half-of-the-tenth-part-is-now-passing-away.

**12:44** Now-then-put-your-house-in-order, and-reprove-your-people, and-comfort-the-lowly-among-them, and-make-to-understand-those-who-are-wise.

**12:45** And-now-therefore-renounce-the-life-that-is-corruptible, and-put-away-the-thought-of-mortal-life, and-put-away-the-weight-of-man, and-put-off-now-the-weak-nature.

**12:46** And-lay-aside-the-thoughts-that-are-most-grievous-to-you, and-hasten-to-escape-from-these-times.

**12:47** For-evils-greater-than-those-which-you-have-now-seen-shall-be-done-hereafter; for-as-much-as-I-have-seen-the-kings-of-the-nations-becoming-more-powerful;

**12:48** and-as-they-increase-their-ungodliness, I-and-those-who-are-like-me-shall-be-troubled.

**12:49** And-it-came-to-pass after-three-days-that-I-sat-under-an-oak; and-no-man-was-with-me.

**12:50** For-all-men-had-gathered-together-to-lament-because-I-had-tarried-so-long; and-I-opened-my-mouth and-began-to-speak-to-them.

**12:51** And-I-said: Hear-me, Israel! and-give-ear-to-my-words, you-seed-of-Jacob!
